title: NumberField props
description: A NumberField item's props (FR-13, atoms design decision 1): a label of 1 to 200 characters, an optional description of 1 to 1000, optional min and max within a quadrillion either way, an optional step above 0, an optional integer and an optional unit of 1 to 20 characters. That max is not below min is a check of numberFieldPropsProblems. In the input format since atoms.
